title: Our Orchestras
description: The Alpharetta High School orchestras, from entry level to elite: Concert, Silver, Philharmonia, Sinfonia, Symphony and Chamber.

blocks.title: About the Orchestras
blocks.lede: The Alpharetta High School Orchestra program is home to around 130 students across five distinct performance levels, offering daily string instruction that builds technique, musicianship, ear training, and both solo and ensemble skills.

blocks.md:
Our goal is to develop thriving, independent musicians who carry a lifelong love of music beyond the classroom.

Under the direction of Jake Hood, the program continues Alpharetta’s long-standing reputation for excellence in music-making, with an emphasis on individual student growth, community outreach, and chamber music. Students benefit from outstanding facilities, a supportive administration, and a dedicated parent booster organization.

blocks.heading: Our ensembles, from entry to elite level

items.title: Concert Orchestra
items.detail: Our entry-level ensemble for freshmen, developing performers building toward third-position playing

items.title: Silver Orchestra
items.detail: The same entry level as Concert, for sophomores through seniors

items.title: Philharmonia
items.detail: Intermediate-level performers expanding technique through shifting and vibrato

items.title: Sinfonia
items.detail: Advanced-level performers working through fifth position and more demanding repertoire

items.title: Symphony
items.detail: Our premier full symphony orchestra for mastery-level performers, including winds, brass, and percussion

items.title: Chamber Orchestra
items.detail: Our elite ensemble, performing the most challenging string repertoire
